ui.chat.tag_dialogs.deleted_name.note: Past-tense confirmation announced after the delete write succeeds. Preserve the {name} argument.

ui.chat.tag_dialogs.created_assigned.note: Confirms the new tag was created and assigned to the conversation in one action. Preserve the {name} argument.

ui.chat.tag_dialogs.assign_created_faile.note: The registry write succeeded but assigning the new tag did not. Says the tag exists and how to add it, so the user does not retry Create and hit a duplicate. Preserve the {name} argument.

ui.chat.tag_dialogs.changed_elsewhere.note: Announced after a 409: another client changed this conversation's tags. States that the list has already been refreshed to their values and that the next selection is a deliberate retry, so the user does not read it as an unexplained failure or as their edit having been applied.
